model.name: official_reports_learnable_v1
model.description: Official sources only (US/JP/CN/EU/UK public RSS·HTML). Domains: economy/finance/diplomacy/security/agriculture. Series catalog + label_history for collaborative learning. No Dropbox.

learning.how: Append JSONL rows when you decide a report is 의미 있음/없음; next build adjusts series multipliers. New series go into series_catalog.json.
